title: QMBL: Open Problems entry (metadata.yaml)
description: One entry: one state of one system on one instance. scripts/validate.mjs checks every metadata.yaml against this file; it reads type, required, properties, additionalProperties, enum, pattern, minimum and minLength.

system.description: The method or AI system the entry evaluates. One live entry per system and instance: a new entry of the same system replaces the old one.

team.description: Who made the entry: names or group.

contact.description: An email address for questions about the entry.

ai_involvement.description: ai: an AI system did the work end to end. human+ai: people and AI systems both did substantial parts. human: no AI system beyond ordinary tools.

instance.description: A QMBL instance id from targets/v1.json, e.g. J1J2/square_100_P_0.5.

energy_per_site.description: The entrant's own measurement, per site in the convention qmbl.org prints: S.S per site for spin models, total / N for fermions.

sigma_per_site.description: Its error bar per site, if you have one: asked for, not required, as for every QMBL row (RULES.md section 6). Null or left out for a deterministic state (an MPS contracted exactly).

sigma_method.description: How sigma was estimated; required when sigma_per_site is given.

samples.description: Number of samples behind the measurement, if known; null or left out for a deterministic state.

framework.description: How the verifier loads the state (its README, 'The state you submit'): flax (a module returning log psi), torch (an nn.Module), jax (JAX without flax: apply_fn(params, x)), julia (logpsi in a .jl file), c (a shared library exporting logpsi), python (a numpy host function), or mps (an HDF5 file in the verifier's MPS_FORMAT.md, contracted exactly).

entry_point.description: Inside the code: file.py:NAME for flax, torch, jax and python; file.jl for julia; the built lib.so for c. Null or left out for mps.

build.description: Optional shell command run in the code checkout before measuring, e.g. the compile step of a c state.

kernel.description: Optional file.py:factory for a bounded local-energy kernel (large fermion systems, flax only).

code_url.description: Public code at a fixed commit.

checkpoint_url.description: Public download of the parameter file (flax msgpack, torch state_dict, npz or msgpack pytree, or a file the julia, c or python state reads itself) or, for mps, the HDF5 file. Required for flax, torch, jax and mps.

checkpoint_sha256.description: SHA-256 of that file; required with checkpoint_url.
